    Where the money leaks

    A missed call used to cost you nothing. Now it costs you the rental.

    He used to call back in five minutes. Now the national answers at midnight, so he just calls them instead. Nothing about your yard got worse. The cost of missing him did.

    01

    The missed call

    Lunch rush, after hours, everyone loading a truck, and the phone rings out. A renter doesn't leave voicemail twice. He calls the next yard on the map.

    You never find out he called.

    02

    The dead quote

    You priced the job, sent it over, and nothing. Nobody has time to chase quotes, so "let me check with my guy" quietly becomes somebody else's contract.

    The pile only gets older.

    03

    The quiet account

    Contractors who rented from you for ten years, then stopped. No complaint, no goodbye. They just started renting from whoever picked up that Tuesday.

    They still have credit on file with you.

    Straight answers

    Questions owners actually ask

    No fine print, no runaround. If your question isn't here, ask us and a real person answers, usually the same day.

    Still have a question? Get the free audit or just email us. Either way, no pressure. Get a free audit ↗ or use the audit form
    What does it cost?+

    Core yards start with the 30-Day Rental Rescue: $200 per completed rental, $0 upfront for the founding cohort. Quote-heavy yards start with the 30-Day Quote Recovery Pilot: $1,200 flat. Your quote page goes live in a day and we work your best 100 dead quotes for 30 days at no extra charge. Convert and that $1,200 comes off the $3,000 build, so you owe $1,800. Ongoing Desk pricing depends on whether Core or Full Counter fits the numbers.

    What is the Quote Recovery Pilot?+

    For $10M+ quote-heavy yards, $1,200 buys the quote-and-booking page on your site, live within a day. The 30 days of dead-quote work is free on top. That month is us proving it, so we do not charge for it. You get contacted, interested, booked, completed, dashboard-attributed booked rental revenue, and lost reasons. Convert to Full Counter and the $1,200 credits against the $3,000 build, leaving $1,800. Do not convert and you keep the page running at $300 a month, or walk.

    I don't want anyone texting my customers.+

    Fair, and we don't blast your list. We start with people already reaching out to you, and quote follow-up is for people who asked you for a price. Past-customer work is separate, only your own people, and you approve every message in your own words before one goes out.

    Who owns the result?+

    A named RentalRevive manager owns your number. Full Counter yards also get a managed Revenue Coordinator working the quote pile. Your counter keeps the customer relationship; we make sure the follow-up happens and the recovered dollars are visible.

    My counter already does follow-up.+

    Great. The audit will show that. The question is whether every quote gets chased to a yes or a no, and what those recovered rentals were worth last month. We work around the counter process you already use. Nobody switches anything.

    What happens to my customer list?+

    It stays yours. We use it only for your work, never share, sell, or reuse it, and delete it on request when we're done. That's in writing, in the agreement.

    What if you book nothing?+

    On the Core Rescue, if no rental goes out, you pay nothing. On the Quote Recovery Pilot, you keep the scorecard: contacted, interested, booked, lost reasons, and what the quote pile is really worth.

    Why only five yards to start?+

    Because we actually do the work, and reply speed is the whole product. When a caught caller answers, someone hands him to your counter within the hour. That doesn't scale past a handful of new yards at once, so the free-to-start Rescue is capped at the first five, one per city.

    Do you work outside the US?+

    Yes. The scan and the audit run for independent yards in the US, Australia, and the Gulf: UAE, Oman, Qatar, Bahrain and Kuwait. Type your company name and the scan finds you the same way your customers do.

    Estimates are priced in US dollars for now, with the arithmetic shown line by line, so restating any number in your own rates takes a minute and a calculator.

    What if my yard is too small for all this?+

    Then we'll tell you, and we won't sell you a Desk. The audit shows whether there's enough on the table to pay for one. If there isn't, a Desk would be us taking your money.

    For smaller yards there's Yard Dog: $1,200 to set up, $300 a month. It runs the counter side only: the 60-Second Quote on your site and a live booking and inventory page, working 24/7. No coordinator, no weekly calls, no chasing. It shows you the quotes piling up; it doesn't work them. We keep seven of these slots, total, and if you ever move up to the Desk the setup comes off the build.

    Yard Dog runs your counter. The Desk runs your revenue.
